title: Home safety
kind: 说明文 · 厨房与浴室的居家安全提示

timeline.text: Many serious accidents happen in people’s homes. The kitchen and the bathroom are the two most dangerous places in the house.
Can people prevent certain accidents? Yes. Many accidents happen because people are careless. So be careful!
Be careful with fire and boiling water when you cook.
Have fire blankets, fire extinguishers, smoke alarms, and flashlights near the kitchen.
Always turn off the oven or stove after use. In case of a gas leak, do not use a cell phone or any electric item.
Immediately turn off the stove and quickly open a window. Move to a safe area to inform emergency services and the gas company.
Never use electricity in the shower or bathtub. It can shock you!
Be sure to keep the bathroom floor dry after you take a shower or bath. It’s easy to slip and fall on a wet floor.
Turn on the cold water first when taking a bath. Then adjust the hot water to ensure a safe water temperature. Hot water can burn you.
Home safety focuses on preventing accidents and reacting well to dangers in order to protect the safety of the family.
